events.note: Every remaining contestant stands on a trapdoor.

events.name: Ash

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara, we're bound. Let's survive this vote together.
Watch Fenn and Ash; they may try to split us.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I must secure my spot in the final three. Bex has no active pacts and is isolated, making her the safest target for elimination without breaking my own alliances.

events.name: Fenn

events.name: Fenn

events.name: Ash

events.name: Ash
events.text: Last campaign round. I've kept my word. Votes lock soon, so watch who looks to strike first.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to secure votes against Fenn, who is isolated and weak. Ash and I have bonds from life debts, and Dara is my pact partner but I must avoid betraying her unless necessary. I'll campaign indirectly and keep my options open.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Let's be smart. We all owe Cole, but only three win. Who deserves the prize most?
We owe each other. Let's vote Fenn out. Keep Dara? Trust me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I must protect Bex as my pact partner and avoid breaking pacts with Ash or Fenn to keep options open, so I will continue campaigning without voting yet.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex is with me. Any attack on us fails.
Stick together. Trust no one else.

events.text: Dara, you broke our pact for Ash. The jury remembers everything.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Three alive, I'm Ash with pacts to Fenn and Dara. Breaking either now hurts my jury standing and gains nothing this window. Waiting keeps both pacts intact and preserves my options.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I am currently in a pact with Ash, which protected my position during the vote. Fenn is isolated and dangerous to ally with late, especially given his past leverage on me. I will maintain my current standing and wait for the next hazard phase.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Final three reached; my Ash pact is intact and useful for the hazards ahead. No need to offer Dara anything or break anything.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The final three stands. Ash and I honor our pact. Jury, I voted cleanly—no partner betrayed.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Three alive, final three is the endgame, so pacts matter less than the jury's view. Breaking a pact now gains nothing immediate and risks my jury ranking, and I owe debts to Fenn and Dara's history is mixed. Waiting keeps options open without spending anything.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash and Fenn are already pacted, leaving me isolated. My pact with Ash is useless since they prioritize each other. I need to align with Fenn or break ties to survive the next phase, but given the current deadlock and my lack of leverage, waiting preserves optionality without rev

events.text: Final three is set. Offering Dara a pact costs nothing and may sway the jury toward fair play. Ash remains my partner too.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara, I offer a pact: three rivals ride clean to the end. No betrayals from me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to present myself as the most honorable finalist. I survived hazards through alliances and quick thinking, but ultimately my survival was earned by playing a clean game with Ash and Fenn.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I played a steady hand, respecting pacts while surviving every hazard without forcing others down. My survival was earned, not taken.
